app.tagline: The coral reefs of the Bay Islands, Honduras
home.sub: Explore Roatán, Utila, Guanaja and Cayos Cochinos with real satellite data: ocean heat since 1985, reef habitat maps and the shape of each island.
home.mapLabel: Map of the Bay Islands with today's heat stress
home.mapNote: Colored squares: today's heat stress in 5 km satellite cells.
home.cardsLead: Degree heating weeks (DHW): how much extra heat has built up over the last 12 weeks. From 4, bleaching is expected; from 8, severe bleaching and coral death.
home.stripesTitle: 42 years of heat, island by island
home.stripesLead: Each stripe is one year: the worst heat stress that island had. The darker, the more heat built up.
home.caveat: These data measure ocean temperature in 5 km cells around each island. They are a regional signal, not a measurement on any one reef.
alert.building.desc: Heat building up: risk of possible bleaching.
alert.a2.desc: Risk of reef-wide bleaching with death of heat-sensitive corals.
alert.a4.desc: Risk of severe, multi-species mortality (over 50% of corals).
alert.a5.desc: Risk of near-complete mortality (over 80% of corals).
heat.title: Heat stress by island
heat.lead: NOAA publishes ocean heat for the whole world, but not island by island. Here we compute it for each island group from the daily 5 km satellite grid.
heat.chartLead: Average degree heating weeks around each island. The shaded band is bleaching season (August–October).
scene.exaggeration: Relief exaggerated ×4; depths beyond 40 m compressed.
scene.modelNote: Satellite-based model; not a navigation chart.
scene.depthModel: Shallow depths estimated from reef zones (satellite bathymetry pending).
scene.heatNote: Each square is one 5 km satellite cell: a regional signal, not a measurement on a reef.
scene.noWebgl: Your device can't show 3D. You can see each island's data under Heat stress.
scene.modelSoon: 3D model of a real coral: coming soon.
learn.title: Learn about reefs
learn.lead: Short explanations to understand what the maps and charts show.
about.title: Data & credits
about.lead: ReefQuest is free and nonprofit. Everything you see comes from open data, processed by us and stored on this site. This is how it works and where its limits are.
about.caveatsTitle: What these data can and can't tell you
nowebgl.title: Your device can't show 3D
nowebgl.body: You can still use the map and the heat-stress charts.
footer.made: Made in Honduras for the islands' schools, communities and divers.
